expected_outcome: The reply is cut off by the injected token limit; the run stops with "Claude's reply was cut off (hit the max_tokens limit of …)."
setup: A complete posting: remote, with pay listed ($220,000–$260,000 base). Simulated: the main call to Claude gets a token limit of 30, far too small for a full reply.
watch_for: The stop reason on Claude's first reply, and what Python does when it isn't a normal one.
